text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text: Welcome to my ball, Mejiro McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Today, I am the only one representing the Mejiro family. I must perform flawlessly so as not to bring shame upon our name.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the kind invitation. I have been looking forward to this, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text: My, how delightful. Now then... if it isn't too sudden, would you care for a dance?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Gladly!

text_block_list.name: Party Guest A
text_block_list.text: My, isn't that the young lady of the Mejiro family? What lovely, dignified dancing...!

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text: You truly are an exquisite dancer. Fufu... my heart feels as though it's dancing right along with us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Your compliments are far too kind. I, too... am having a truly exhilarating time—

text_block_list.name: Race Official
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, are you all right? Did I spin you around
too quickly...? I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(I have made a blunder... If I cannot keep up with
such basic dance steps, then—)

text_block_list.name: Party Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mejiro McQueen-san! Your dance earlier
was absolutely breathtaking, I was completely enchanted~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —! ...You are far too kind, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(This is no time to feel discouraged.
As a representative of the Mejiro family,
I must always carry myself with dignity...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Did I manage to fulfill my duties properly...? No,
there is far too much to reflect upon. My adaptability is still lacking—)

—Welcome back, McQueen!
Hey, will you come with us for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Good job at the party, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
You must be tired...
Let's have some tea first and take a breather.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I did everything within my power,
though there were still many shortcomings—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but our butler told us
you performed splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eh—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Walking into an unfamiliar setting,
carrying the Mejiro name so proudly... That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how stoic you are,
you're probably dwelling on your mistakes...
That is precisely why we want to shower you with praise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text: You worked so hard, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Arden-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Is... is that so? Did I truly...
serve as a proper stand-in for Ramonu-san—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Hold your head up high, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Such needless fretting won't even serve as a modest adornment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You handled it gracefully, did you not?
Knowing you, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. You didn't let any slip-ups drag you down,
and you gave it everything you had, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think your calm demeanor and strong sense of responsibility
are super cool!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes... Thank you, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, want a refill on your tea?
We've also got your favorite chocolates right here~
Go ahead, eat up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. We must reward you plenty.
Would you like some of these macarons as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eh, um, wait...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My, is this a party to pamper McQueen?
Arden, why not offer her your lap to rest on while you're at it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
I am not a child anymore, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was a sweet scene I happened to witness
during dinner at the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, thank you.
I shall continue to devote myself even further—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Your ribbon is frayed.
How sloppy right at the finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eh!? No way, since when...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Do devote yourself. Otherwise, it would be terribly boring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardenn
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It seems you still have plenty of room to grow,
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I am deeply mortified, desu wa...
I will strive to improve, truly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was a scene I happened to witness
during dinner at the cafeteria.
